False pass from metadata only, invalid or missing rendered MP4, inconsistent receipt SHA
Frame omissions in audio-framed render, muted movie, lost claims, skipped graph

acceptance: Either valid native creative H264/AAC QA-gated outputs with strict receipts and negatives, or reproducible NO-GO with exact blockers. No faked generic all-frame QA.
